system.description:
Bless a field of crops, preventing blight, and ensuring that they will yield a bountiful harvest. So long as this ability is maintained till harvest prevent any blight or plant sickness from impacting these fields and double their output at harvest time.

At Arcane Might II you may bless the crops in a village sized area enhancing a maximum of a thousand farm capacity with a single ritual. At Arcane Might III you may cover the area of a town and its immediate surrounding fields, enhancing a maximum of ten thousand capacity. At Arcane Might V you may provide your blessing to an entire region enhancing a maximum of a hundred thousand capacity.
system.costNote: 5 Favor per thousand Capacity at Arcane Might II, 3 at III, 2 at IV
